# Tests that fail on main today. The factory gate runs them with a strict
# xfail marker (see .github/scripts/factory_gate_pytest.py): a listed test
# that fails is reported but does not turn the gate red, and a listed test that
# passes turns it red until its line is removed here.
#
# Only Onur adds lines. The test-removal check fails any change that adds one.
#
# Format: <pytest node id> | <cause>

pharmacies/tests/test_tasks.py::test_run_scraper_handles_istanbul_request_failures_through_dispatcher | Reaches the database through an unmocked close_old_connections() without a django_db mark. Fails when an earlier test left a connection open.
pharmacies/tests/test_tasks.py::test_run_scraper_retries_real_persistence_helper_path | Reaches the database through an unmocked close_old_connections() without a django_db mark. Fails when an earlier test left a connection open.
tests/test_location_coverage.py::TestLocationCoverage::test_smoke_scenarios | Since 7d62080 (#183), get_pharmacy_points returns 502 when the Distance Matrix call fails. The "Eskisehir - Anadolu University" scenario has no distancematrix snapshot, so the stub answers REQUEST_DENIED, and the test expects 400. While listed, the other scenarios in this test are not checked either.
tests/test_performance.py::TestPerformance::test_spatial_query_performance_under_load | Calls the real Google Maps Geocoding and Distance Matrix APIs, because it does not use the mock_google_maps fixture. The gate blocks the network; locally it needs internet and a real API key.
